# BOLERO_CACHEPROG unset
env BOLERO_CACHEPROG=

bolero env
stdout 'BOLERO_CACHEPROG=''?''?'

bolero env -changed
! stdout 'BOLERO_CACHEPROG'

bolero env -changed -json
! stdout 'BOLERO_CACHEPROG'

# BOLERO_CACHEPROG set
[short] skip 'compiles and runs a go program'

bolero build -o cacheprog$GOEXE cacheprog.go

env BOLERO_CACHEPROG=$BOLERO_PATH/src/cacheprog$GOEXE

bolero env
stdout 'BOLERO_CACHEPROG=''?'$BOLERO_CACHEPROG'''?'

bolero env -changed
stdout 'BOLERO_CACHEPROG=''?'$BOLERO_CACHEPROG'''?'

bolero env -changed -json
stdout '"BOLERO_CACHEPROG": ".*cacheprog'$GOEXE'"'

-- cacheprog.go --
// This is a minimal BOLERO_CACHEPROG program that can't actually do anything but exit.
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "os"
)

func main() {
    json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string][]string{"KnownCommands": {"close"}})
    var res struct{}
    json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&res)
}
